details.user_story: As a developer, I want MainApp separated into its own component file so that App.js focuses only on navigation setup and MainApp is self-contained and testable.
details.context: App.js currently contains the MainApp component (600+ lines) along with navigation configuration. This makes the file difficult to navigate and test. Industry best practice is to separate concerns: App.js handles app-level setup/navigation, while feature components live in dedicated files.
acceptance_criteria: App.js imports MainApp from new location
App.js reduced to ~100 lines (just navigation setup)
App works exactly as before (no functional changes)
MainApp uses centralized THEME from src/styles/theme.js

files_modified: diamondmind-mobile/App.js - Import MainApp instead of defining it
implementation: Move all MainApp-specific styles to MainApp.styles.js
Import THEME from src/styles/theme.js in MainApp.styles.js
Export MainApp as default from MainApp.js
Update App.js to import MainApp from './src/components/MainApp'
Test in Expo to verify no regressions

edge_cases: Ensure all imports (useState, useRef, useContext, etc.) are in MainApp.js
Verify UserContext is properly imported in MainApp
Check that video player hooks work in extracted component
Ensure styles reference works correctly from separate file
Validate Metro bundler resolves new component path
